Which menu items are highest in negative feedback?

🍽️ **Top Problem Dishes**
**Chhola Bhatura** and **Jalebi** are drawing the most heat — together they account for nearly half of all food complaints.

⚠️ **What Customers Are Saying**
Guests felt the bhaturas were overcooked and oily, while jalebis tasted sour with old batter. A few customers also flagged issues with **Kachoris** (broken, poor taste) and **Coconut Chutney** (off flavor). Portion sizes on items like **Rasgulla** and **Chena** also disappointed diners who expected more for the price.

✅ **Recommended Action**
Start with a quality check on **Jalebi** batter freshness and **Chhola Bhatura** prep — focus on oil temperature and cooking time to restore consistency.
